what: Layers of misty mountain ridges are laid across the bottom of the section (each layer is a seeded random midpoint-displacement ridge · dark at the top fading toward the bottom · back layers faint, the front layer in the accent color). While the section passes through the screen, each layer is pushed up and down at a different speed (the nearer the layer, the more it moves), creating depth — a section that uses a regional mountain-range silhouette as the section boundary

duration.scrub: From when the section touches the bottom of the screen until it exits at the top

options.seed: Ridge seed (integer), default 7 — differs per section
options.speeds: Parallax share per layer (comma-separated, back→front), default .02,.05,.08,.11 — ±share×300px over one scroll section
options.--fx-ridge-ink: Front layer color (CSS variable), default --kf-accent — back layers fade by mixing this color with the background

from.where: index.js·shared.js HS.ridge (four hero ridges · under concentric circles · lower tier of the green plane · window) — the original moves mountain ridge SVG artwork laid in STUDIO at a different speed per layer (card scroll-scrub). Ridge shapes are our seeded random drawings, layer count, color steps and parallax shares are copied values
